notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put an activated or triggered ability on the stack under your control.
description:
Put an activated or triggered ability on the stack under your control.
Holding priority, cast Vantress Visions by paying {1}{U}, targeting the ability.
Sculpting Steel and Lucky Clover trigger.
Resolve the Lucky Clover trigger, copying Vantress Visions, with the copy targeting Sculpting Steel's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Vantress Visions, copying Sculpting Steel's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Sculpting Steel's trigger, copying Vantress Visions, with the copy targeting Sculpting Steel's trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.name: Sculpting Steel
uses.cardState: as a copy of Lucky Clover
